citation: UNRESOLVED - no full citation available. The Visscher, Dmoshinskaia, Pellegrini & Rey-Naizaque (2025) meta-analysis (Educational Research Review 49, article 100742, DOI 10.1016/j.edurev.2025.100742) labels this included primary study only as 'Little et al. 2014' and provides no full citation, DOI, report number, or URL.
design: Per registry (studies.csv row 72 / supplement Tables S3.1, S3.2): Teacher/Class-level RCT, Published, Mixed grade level, Low SES, target population All; TPD goal 'Other', Short duration, Researcher/Developer-made test, Two TPD principles, Teacher Coaching=yes, Teacher Performance Standards=no, Teacher Self-Regulation=yes, Teacher Cooperation=no. Outcome subject category 'Other' (i.e., not Reading or STEM).
problems: LOCKED: study still could not be identified after a second, exhaustive identification pass; no DOI and no legal OA copy located; no extraction performed. The meta-analysis gives no full citation for included primary studies, and the online supplement (1-s2.0-S1747938X2500079X-mmc1.docx; locally reproduced as data/published/S3.1_methods_units_settings.csv row 73 and S3.2_treatment.csv row 73) contains ONLY moderator codings ('Little et al. 2014 | Teacher/Class | RCT | Published | Mixed | Low SES | All' and 'Little et al. 2014 | Other | Short | Res/Dev | Two | coaching=1 perf=0 self-reg=1 coop=0'), NOT included-study citations. The published article reference list (Educational Research Review 49, art. 100742) was independently re-confirmed via local pdftotext extraction to contain only methodological references (the only 'little' hits are lowercase prose and a 'Doolittle' co-author in a Garet et al. citation). DECISIVE NEW FINDING (second pass): a COMPLETE enumeration of every 2014 publication with any author surnamed 'Little' shows that NO first-author 'Little (2014)' teacher-PD RCT with a student-achievement outcome exists in any index. Channels exhausted: (1) Crossref full enumeration of 2014 journal-articles author=Little (23 records; only ONE is an education-intervention RCT: Little, C.A., McCoach & Reis 2014, the SEM-R differentiated-READING study); (2) ERIC API author:Little AND publicationdateyear:2014 (31+ records; same single RCT, a Reading/middle-school study); (3) OpenAlex M. Annette Little author A5012655750 (full works list: SRSD line ends 2010, NO 2013/2014/2015 RCT); (4) OpenAlex Catherine A. Little / Google Scholar profile 2012-2016 (her only 2014 RCT is the SEM-R Reading study); (5) WWC SRSD intervention report reference list (Little entries all 2010); (6) srsdonline.org research registry (no Little 2014); (7) SRSD practice-based-PD RCTs cross-checked for a 'Little' co-author (Harris/Lane/Graham 2012 JTE; McKeown/FitzPatrick/Sandmel 2014; Festas et al. 2014 CEP; Mason et al. — none authored by Little); (8) EEF projects (Improving Writing Quality 2014, Changing Mindsets, Philosophy for Children — none authored by Little); (9) Kraft, Blazar & Hogan 2018 coaching review (a Visscher source review) — no Little study surfaced. CLOSEST FALSE LEADS, all rejected: (a) Little, Lane, Harris, Graham, Story & Sandmel (2010) SRSD, Behavioral Disorders 35(2), DOI 10.1177/019874291003500206 — matches the 'Other'/self-regulation/coaching/short/res-dev profile VERY well but is dated 2010 (no 2014 version exists) and is grade 2 only (not 'Mixed'); (b) Little, C.A., McCoach & Reis (2014), 'Effects of Differentiated Reading Instruction on Student Achievement in Middle School', Journal of Advanced Academics 25(4), 384-402, DOI 10.1177/1932202X14549250 — the ONLY real 'Little et al. 2014' cluster RCT with student achievement, BUT it is a differentiated-READING (SEM-R) intervention whose Visscher goal would be coded 'differentiate instruction', not 'Other'; outcomes are reading fluency/comprehension (→ subject Reading, not Other); 4 middle schools / 47 teachers / 2,150 students. Conclusion: the supplement label 'Little et al. 2014' is almost certainly imperfect (wrong first author, wrong year, and/or an unindexed report/dissertation) and cannot be resolved without the authors' included-study reference list. RECOMMENDED ACTION: obtain the meta-analysis's included-study bibliography (via the pending data request to a.j.visscher@utwente.nl, see email/data_request.md), then re-run identification + legal-OA lookup.
